rationale.conceptual: Requires careful implementation of a DFT workflow with pressure optimization and DFPT phonons for a specific clathrate structure; the method is well-established but not a trivial copy-paste.
rationale.execution: Three-step sequential pipeline (optimize, phonon, force) with standard tooling (Quantum ESPRESSO), straightforward I/O, and no complex orchestration or data fetching.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT phonon calculation using open-source code; non-trivial to set up but no novel algorithm.

compute_estimate.reasoning: DFT calculations on a 54-atom unit cell with a plane-wave basis and DFPT phonons are CPU-intensive; moderate memory (~16 GB) suffices.
